conventions.source_of_truth_principle: content lives in ONE canonical location; other folders reference via pointers only

directories.se-roles: Role-specific knowledge, playbooks, certs, learning — one subfolder per specialization
directories.sectors: Vertical/industry-specific content plus account data — one subfolder per sector
directories.onboarding: Phase-based onboarding PATH through content (references into se-roles and shared-resources)
directories.product-updates: Product news by product, with filtered views as pointers
directories.process-guidelines: SOPs, playbooks (cross-role scenarios only), best practices, governance
directories.shared-resources: Org-wide reusable content: templates, glossary, tools, competitive intel
directories.metadata: All mapping/config logic — role, sector, pod, account mappings
